title: NPPA Directs Strict Monitoring of Implementation of TMR on 137 Anti-Cancer Drugs
subtitle: State Drug Controllers to Submit Action Taken Report by 16 November
body_text: The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA), under the Department of Pharmaceuticals, has directed strict monitoring of the implementation of Trade Margin Rationalisation (TMR) on 137 non-scheduled anti-cancer drugs, notified vide Gazette Order dated 17 October 2026, with revised prices effective from 9 November 2026. The latest revised price lists, based on submissions received from companies up to 11 November 2026, are available on the NPPA website and Pharma Sahi Daam app/portal . All manufacturers, retailers, dealers, stockists, hospitals and medical institutions have been directed to comply with the revised prices and prominently display the updated price lists at their premises and websites. State Drug Controllers to Ensure Compliance and Protect Patients' Interests : State Drug Controllers (SDCs) have been directed to strictly monitor compliance by manufacturers, dealers, hospitals and medical institutions to ensure that the benefits of revised MRPs are passed on to patients. Any violation may attract overcharging proceedings under the provisions of DPCO, 2013. Complaints regarding overcharging, shortage or non-availability of medicines can be reported through the Pharma Sahi Daam app/portal, NPPA helpline (1800-111-255) or email (monitoring-nppa[at]gov[dot]in.) State Drug Controllers have been asked to submit their Action Taken Reports to NPPA by 16 November 2026. https://t.co/B9mEk0l7X7 ***** PC/PM
